content: Brahma Satyam Jagan Mithya, Jivo Brahmaiva Naparah. (Brahman alone is real; the universe is phenomenal and illusory; the individual self is none other than Brahman).
author: Adi Shankara
explanation: Shankara's definitive distillation of non-dual philosophy: changing forms of the empirical universe possess dependent reality (*vyavaharika*), while unchanging consciousness (*Brahman*) is the absolute ground of existence (*paramarthika*).
practicalInsight: When anxious about shifting outer circumstances, pause and remember that your witness-consciousness is untouched by the passing drama.
reflectionPrompt: Am I identifying with the changing scenery of life or with the unchanging awareness observing it?
